packet.title: group by and window clauses (implementation) — Early

body.p: After . Owns src/xquery_lower_window.c, src/xquery_flwor.c, tests/xquery_flwor_test.c. The internal native rows of over tuple arrays: group by (grouping keys, collations, deep-equal-style key equality, non-grouping variables become sequences), tumbling and sliding windows (start/end conditions as closures, only end, previous/next variables). Done when prod-GroupByClause and prod-WindowClause ≥ 90%. Spec: XQuery 4.0 "Group By Clause", "Window Clause". Done 2026-10-17 (): group by as a tuple stream clause over the internal group-by row; window clauses as segment clauses over the window row; one condition-closure procedure, also for while. XQ40 (release): prod-GroupByClause 35/40 (38 run; one prolog, one UCA tailoring, one SORT over an empty input in the evaluator), prod-WindowClause 125/158 (139 run; every error a prolog, 3.10). Tests xquery_flwor.
